department: Department of Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science

deadline.value: December 15 annual application deadline for PhD cohort.
deadline.quote: PhD students are admitted as a cohort each Fall semester, and the annual application deadline for both domestic and international students is December 15.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject score requirement not specified on MSCS admissions page.

supervisor.value: Supervisor contact prior to admission not specified.

funding.value: Almost all PhD students are funded throughout their degree via teaching assistantships, research assistantships, fellowships, or external awards, with a stipend plus tuition and service fee waiver.
funding.quote: Almost all PhD students, and many of our masters students, are funded throughout their degree course. Funding for PhD students usual comes in the form of teaching assistantships, but some PhD students are funded by research assistantships, UIC Graduate College Fellowships, and other external awards. | Teaching Assistants (TA) earn a stipend plus a Tuition and Service Fee Waiver.

entry_route.value: Students may apply with or without a master's degree (typically 5 years with a prior MS, 6 years without).
entry_route.quote: Students may apply with or without a Master's degree. For those with a previous Master's degree in mathematics (or related field) the PhD is typically 5 years in duration, whereas for those without a previous Master's degree it is typically 6 years.
